content: Mawari wewiwamete kememɨtepatsie
Yawé Muitsexi katiniuta'aitɨani mawari wewiwamete mɨpaɨ mɨtiwatahɨawekɨ, 'Aruni niwemama: «Xeka'itiyatɨ xepɨkahayuyeitɨaka mɨkite yukiekaritsie xewakumaɨwatɨ,
matsi mɨkɨ xeikɨa mepɨyɨwaweni 'iwaya 'aurawatanaka, maamaya, paapaya, nu'aya 'uki, niweya 'uka, xɨka xewitɨ 'umɨni 'ahurawa 'iwaya
yatɨni 'iwaya 'uka kawikietɨ hetsɨana muka.
Mɨkɨ memanuyetei memɨhɨkɨkɨ yukiekaritsie, meka'itiyatɨ mepɨkahayuyeitɨaka meta mepɨkayutsewiximaka.
»Mawari wewiwamete yumu'utsie mepɨkayukaxikani, yumɨxiya kɨtsie yu'ayekwaitsie mieme mepɨkahataxikani meta yuwaiyaritsie mepɨkayutixitekeni.

Kaneuyeweka memɨpatsiekakɨ yukakaɨyari hetsiemieme, meta mɨkɨ kemɨtitewa kapatsiekame mepɨkahayeitɨwani. Mɨkɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni 'imikieri taipa warɨkariekame Yawé memɨteyetuiriwa, paa yukakaɨyari hetsiemieme hepaɨ mekani'aneneni. 'Ayumieme mekanipatsiekakuni.
»Xewitɨ tɨma mawari wewiwame xeime tuminikɨ mukumayɨiwa pɨkatiwitɨkɨni, yatɨni 'eiriwakame, meta xeime 'uka mayɨiyakame, yukakaɨyari hetsiemieme mɨpatsiekɨ.
Patsiekame kenayeitɨaka, mɨkɨ 'akakaɨyari paa mɨyetuiriwakɨ. 'Ahetsiemieme kanipatsiekamɨkɨ, ne Yawé nemɨpatsiekɨ, xeme xepatsiekame nepɨxe'ayeitɨa.

»Mawari wewiwame niweyatɨtɨ tuminikɨ mukumayɨiwa xɨka 'ayuyeitɨani mɨkɨ yɨkɨmana kapatsietɨ payuyeitɨani yaxeikɨatatsiere yupaapa kapatsiekame kanayeitɨamɨkɨ. Kaneuyeweka 'ayenieretɨ mɨtataiyarienikɨ.
Mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame kemɨtipatsieka

»Kemɨ'ane manayexeiyarieni yu'iwama watsata mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame mayanikɨ, mu'uyatsie hatseiti mɨtiyupata mukawiriyarie, meta kemɨ'ane mawari wewiwamete wakemari manakatɨnikɨ mɨyetuiriyarie, 'aixɨa reyutsiketɨ puyeikani meta yukamixa pɨkaheukatsanani.
»Kaxari muyekatsie tɨma pɨkaheutahakeni. »Ka'itiyatɨ pɨkahayuyeitɨaka, yupaapakɨ meta yumaamakɨ.
»Tukita pɨkawayeyeikani kapa kapatsiekame yukakaɨyari tukieya 'ayeitɨanikɨ, mɨkɨ mɨpatsienikɨ hatseiti mɨtiyupata 'ukawiriyarieka manayexeiyariekɨ yukakaɨyaritsie mieme. Ne Yawé nekanihɨkɨtɨni.
»'Uka mɨtiwitɨni 'ɨyaya mayanikɨ pɨkamayɨiyaka.
Meta wiura pɨkatiwitɨkɨni metatsiere 'eiriwakame, yaxeikɨata tuminikɨ mukumayɨiwa. Matsi memakuteitsie kiekame mɨkamayɨiya kanitiwitɨmɨkɨ,
kapa mekapatsiekame yunuiwari warayeitɨanikɨ yuteɨterima watsata. Ne Yawé nekanihɨkɨtɨni nemɨxepata».
Kemɨreuyewetse memɨ'anenenikɨ mawari wewiwamete
Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniuta'aitɨani
'Aruni mɨpaɨ mɨtitahɨawekɨ: «Xewitɨ 'anuiwaritsiemiemete xɨka yuwaiyaritsie 'aixɨa ka'aneni mɨkɨ pɨkayɨweni 'ahurawa muyanikɨ yukakaɨyari hetsɨa paa mawariyari mɨyetuanikɨ.
Tikuyetɨ yuwaiyaritsie pɨkayɨweni 'ahurawa muyanikɨ mɨpaɨ 'anetɨ: kaheunieretɨ, 'uti'ɨtsaiwatɨ, yɨhɨxie kanɨrietɨ, meta waiyarieyatsie reuyewetɨkaikaku,
'ɨkateya meta mamateya 'akamumurikaku,
'anatutsitɨ meta 'etsi'utewitɨ, meta heunerɨitsietɨ yatɨni haiya xetatɨ mukumarike hexeiyatɨ, hɨxitana tiukuturekaku, yatɨni 'ataripiyatɨ.

Mawari wewiwame 'Aruni nuiwarieya xɨka xewitɨ mɨkɨ kwiniya mɨpaɨ 'aneme hexeiyani pɨkayɨweni 'ahurawa muyanikɨ Yawé 'imikieri taipa warɨkariekame mɨwewirienikɨ. Meta pɨkayɨweni paa mawariyari yukakaɨyari mɨyetuirienikɨ.
Kaniyuwemɨkɨ xeikɨa paa mawariyari meta 'ikwai mɨpatsie meta waɨkawa mɨpatsietɨka mɨtikwanikɨ,
mɨkɨ kwiniya mexeiyakɨ 'ixuriki meuwieta paitɨ pɨkaheutahani meta mawari taiyametsie 'ahurawa pɨka'uyani, kapa netuki kapatsiekame 'ayeitɨakakɨ. Ne Yawé nekanihɨkɨtɨni mawari wewiwamete nemɨwapata».
Muitsexi 'ikɨ naime 'Aruni meta niwemama yaxeikɨata yunaime 'ixaheritsixi katiniwarutaxatɨani.
